## What's Changed
* Speed up startup, scrolling, and note indexing by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/651
* Drop git sync status events for a space the window no longer shows by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/652
* Fix data loss when saving notes with <details> blocks by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/653
* Fix raw HTML blocks corrupting the note after them on save by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/654
* Fix plain-text <, > and & being saved as HTML entities by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/655
* Fix AI composer text scrolling under the control row by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/658
* Replace beautiful-mermaid with Pele for Mermaid rendering by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/659
* Add optional calendar to the sidebar by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/660
* Fix dialog backdrop flashing back after its close animation by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/661
* Move space switcher into the sidebar header by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/662
* Hide Tasks in the sidebar by default (#663) [Release] by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/663
* Animated dropdowns: move menus and selects to Animate UI by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/664
* Animate UI polish: gliding highlight, segmented pickers, calendar collapse, link preview card by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/665
* Fix new code blocks going blank when the cursor leaves them by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/666
* Add setting to show or hide task progress rings by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/667
* Remove white bands behind appearance picker section labels by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/668


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/compare/v0.9.2...v0.9.3
